text:
Alex: Heads-up, watching an apdex SLO drop on /chat/generate around 18:30 UTC — dashboards show latency tail increasing when prefix cache hit-rate dips below ~28%. Pushed a live dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/prefix-apdex?range=1h :warning:

Priya: I saw correlated kernel selection changes — fallback to float32 kernels for model rwd-3-small when quantized path failed. Kernel selector logs: `kernel=fp32 reason=quant-path-mismatch` around same window.

Ben: Added a per-customer token-saved panel -> two customers (acme-inc, blueai) have hit-rates ~10% vs baseline 40%. Possibly prompt canonicalization mismatch after PR#4567.

Linda: Confirmed PR#4567 changed whitespace normalization + removed lowercasing for system prompts. That would change cache keys. Rolling an experiment to re-run key normalization on a 1% traffic slice.

Alex: Can we correlate batch size? My profiling snippet shows larger batch sizes amplify latency for fp32 kernels. Profiling query:
```
select model, avg(batch_size), p50_latency_ms, prefix_hit_rate
from profiling.events
where route='/chat/generate' and ts > now()-3600
group by model
```

Priya: Also seeing KV cache churn: warmup misses spike after the change; warmup agent logs show `evict_on_update=true` race in scheduler. Potential bug in KV eviction pointer.

Ben: Proposed short-term mitigation: fall back to a cached-compatible canonicalizer in routing that preserves previous keying for 30 days (feature flagged). Long-term: A/B traffic to newer keying and update warmup prefetch generators.

Linda: I pushed a dashboard update with per-model, per-route, per-tenant token-saved waterfall + a time-series of kernel selection events. Please review: https://dash.internal/redwood/prefix-apdex-2

ops-bot: alert acknowledged by @eng-runtime. Incident ticket: IN-2026 created, runbook attached.

Alex: Action items — (1) run 1% revert/canonicalizer test (Linda), (2) inspect kernel selector fallback rules and add guardrails (Priya), (3) notify CS for affected tenants and set temporary rate-limits if needed (Ben). Will sync in 20m.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll instrument an event to tag kernel fallback with `cache_key_mismatch=true`.

Ben: Adding a postmortem template to the ticket. Short notes in the ticket will include token-saved deltas and customer impact.

Linda: Started experiment — toggled feature flag for 1% traffic at 19:02 UTC. Monitoring.

Alex: Thanks team, keeping this thread as single source. Ping if you see anything that looks like regression to older baseline.
